## Body

Complements the credential-rotation note: this is about receive readiness and audit visibility, not retry authorization.

A client's own inbox timeout proves no response, not a healthy receiver. In #277, a delayed 401 reproduced false reconnected. Require a positive daemon answer; the 55-second native empty-page answer fits under the 65-second client timeout. Check mail arriving at 54.9 seconds in ordinary and during-turn claims, and keep non-native waits unchanged.

An edge set tested only within one process misses restart duplicates. Reopen the same SQLite store after a recorded lapse: there must remain one outstanding lapse, followed by one renewal. Restore via seat-and-kind-indexed LIMIT 1 reads, not spine.tail; the two edge kinds require two seeks per live native seat, once at boot.

A bounded dedupe window must not silently hide an unseen key when full. Exercise a distinct seat after 512 pairs. Oldest-entry eviction preserves visibility; equal timestamps need an explicit secondary key if deterministic order matters.

Evidence: #277 final reviewer output 2026-11/20-verdict-pr-277-5e700ab.dd.json; original late-401, SQLite-restart and capacity regressions all passed after repair.
